headlines.title: 意大利第二季度经济增速超预期
headlines.summary: 意大利周四公布的初步数据显示，第二季度经济较前三个月增长0.2%，略高于市场预期，为今年经济前景提供了支撑。意大利国家统计局表示，意大利4月至6月国内生产总值（GDP）同比增长1.0%，也明显高于市场预期。经济学家此前预计GDP环比增长0.1%，同比增长0.7%。数据表明，尽管伊朗冲突导致能源成本大幅上升，意大利经济表现仍好于市场预期。意大利国家统计局表示，第二季度环比增长主要得益于国内需求的正向贡献，其增量足以抵消贸易对经济增长造成的拖累。统计局在初步数据中未公布各项分项的具体数据，但表示服务业实现增长，而工业和农业均出现萎缩。

headlines.title_en: Italy's Q2 economic growth exceeds expectations
headlines.summary_en: Italy's preliminary data released on Thursday showed the economy grew 0.2% in the second quarter from the previous three months, slightly above market expectations, providing support for the economic outlook this year. Italy's National Institute of Statistics said GDP rose 1.0% year-on-year from April to June, also significantly above market expectations. Economists had forecast GDP growth of 0.1% quarter-on-quarter and 0.7% year-on-year. The data indicated that Italy's economy performed better than expected despite a sharp rise in energy costs due to the Iran conflict. ISTAT said the quarterly growth was mainly driven by a positive contribution from domestic demand, which was enough to offset the drag from trade on economic growth. The institute did not release details of sub-items in the preliminary data but said services grew while industry and agriculture contracted.

headlines.title_en: Eurozone Q2 economic growth exceeds expectations
headlines.summary_en: Eurostat data released on Thursday showed that eurozone GDP grew 1% year-on-year and 0.4% quarter-on-quarter in the second quarter, both above market expectations. The market had expected the second quarter to be a recovery starting point for the European economy after a difficult and turbulent year, but surging energy costs weakened much of the recovery momentum. Most institutions expect the eurozone's annual economic growth rate to be below 1% this year. However, the eurozone economy still shows some positive signs. Investment by European companies in artificial intelligence is also surging, household consumption has shown resilience unaffected by pessimistic expectations, and the long-depressed industrial sector has shown surprising resilience in coping with high energy costs and may have contributed to economic growth, unlike in previous years when it was a persistent drag. headlines.title: 荣耀终端更新IPO辅导备案报告
headlines.summary: 证监会官网IPO辅导公示系统显示，中信证券股份有限公司发布了《关于荣耀首次公开发行股票并上市辅导工作进展情况报告（第四期）》。荣耀于2025年6月在深圳市证监局完成上市辅导备案，此前已经发布了三期辅导备案报告。第四期的辅导围绕四个方面展开：持续开展全面尽职调查工作、召开项目工作会议、协助完善公司治理制度、协助辅导对象论证募集资金投资项目。下一阶段，中信证券拟继续委派现有辅导工作小组成员执行辅导工作。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: Honor Device updates IPO coaching filing report
headlines.summary_en: The CSRC's IPO coaching disclosure system showed that CITIC Securities Co., Ltd. released the 'Report on the Progress of Coaching Work for Honor's Initial Public Offering and Listing (Phase IV)'. Honor completed its IPO coaching filing with the Shenzhen Securities Regulatory Bureau in June 2025 and had previously released three coaching filing reports. The fourth phase of coaching revolves around four aspects: continuing comprehensive due diligence, holding project work meetings, assisting in improving corporate governance systems, and helping the coaching target argue for the use of raised funds. In the next stage, CITIC Securities plans to continue assigning existing coaching work team members to carry out coaching work. (Securities Times)

headlines.title_en: CPC Central Committee holds symposium with non-party figures, Xi Jinping presides and delivers important speech
headlines.summary_en: According to CCTV, on July 24, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held a symposium in Zhongnanhai to hear opinions and suggestions from leading figures of democratic parties, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-party individuals on the current economic situation and economic work for the second half of the year. General Secretary Xi Jinping presided over the symposium and delivered an important speech emphasizing that for economic work in the second half of the year, it is necessary to adhere to the general principle of seeking progress while maintaining stability, fully, accurately, and comprehensively implement the new development concept, accelerate the construction of a new development pattern, better coordinate domestic and international situations, balance development and security, adhere to deepening reform and opening up, accelerate the transformation of old and new growth drivers, implement more proactive fiscal policies and moderately accommodative monetary policies, fully leverage the effectiveness of various existing policies, promptly plan and introduce practical and effective incremental policies, increase counter-cyclical adjustment efforts, expand domestic demand, optimize supply, effectively ensure and improve people's livelihoods, enhance development momentum, and stimulate vitality.

headlines.title_en: Beijing Shunyi residential land sold at 12.57% premium
headlines.summary_en: On July 30, Beijing offered three residential-commercial plots for sale. Among them, a plot in Shunyi District's Fuqian Street has a planned building area of 43,387.66 square meters, a floor area ratio of 1.4, a starting price of 738 million yuan, and a starting floor price of 17,009 yuan per square meter. It attracted three real estate companies to bid on-site, with 114 rounds of bidding. Ultimately, Cangzhou Jiuxi Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. won the plot at a total price of 830.8 million yuan, with a transaction floor price of 19,148 yuan per square meter and a premium rate of 12.57%.

headlines.title: 香港证监会：向经纪行发出限制通知书以冻结与涉嫌首次公开招股欺诈有关的逾1.25亿港元资产
headlines.summary: 据香港证监会网站，香港证监会向富途证券国际（香港）有限公司（富途）发出限制通知书，禁止其处理或处置由某实体持有的客户帐户内的资产，以125,247,000港元为限。该实体涉嫌参与一项欺诈计划，旨在营造首次公开招股股份需求的虚假或非真实表象。富途并非香港证监会的调查对象，而该限制通知书亦不会影响富途或其其他客户。

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC issues restriction notices to brokers to freeze over HK$125 million in assets linked to suspected IPO fraud
headlines.summary_en: According to the Hong Kong SFC website, the SFC issued a restriction notice to Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited (Futu), prohibiting it from handling or disposing of assets in client accounts held by a certain entity, capped at HKD 125,247,000. The entity is suspected of participating in a fraudulent scheme aimed at creating a false or misleading appearance of demand for IPO shares. Futu is not the subject of the SFC's investigation, and the restriction notice will not affect Futu or its other clients.

headlines.summary: 意大利周四公布的初步数据显示，第二季度经济较前三个月增长0.2%，略高于市场预期，为今年经济前景提供了支撑。意大利国家统计局表示，意大利4月至6月国内生产总值（GDP）同比增长1.0%，也明显高于市场预期。经济学家此前预计GDP环比增长0.1%，同比增长0.7%。数据表明，尽管伊朗冲突导致能源成本大幅上升，意大利经济表现仍好于市场预期。意大利国家统计局表示，第二季度环比增长主要得益于国内需求的正向贡献，其增量足以抵消贸易对经济增长造成的拖累。统计局在初步数据中未公布各项分项的具体数据，但表示服务业实现增长，而工业和农业均出现萎缩。

headlines.title: 林园投资：部分产品维持原合同约定不再接受申购
headlines.summary: 深圳市林园投资管理有限责任公司发布公告称，169只私募基金产品维持原合同约定不再接受申购，相关产品不再修改基金合同以适配《私募证券投资基金运作指引》的要求，维持原合同条款及投资自由度不变。林园投资解释称，公司产品的投资运作一直坚持适度集中、长期投资的风格，这与《运作指引》中关于组合投资“双25%”限制及债券投资比例限制等条款存在冲突。若强行修改，将造成产品现在或未来被迫调仓，在目前及未来的市场环境下可能对现有持有人利益造成实质损害。自2026年8月1日起，客户持有的产品将不再接受新增申购，产品到期后不展期，按合同约定正常清算。

headlines.title_en: Linyuan Investment: Some products maintain original contract terms, no longer accept subscriptions
headlines.summary_en: Shenzhen Linyuan Investment Management Co., Ltd. issued an announcement stating that 169 private fund products will maintain the original contract agreements and no longer accept subscriptions. The related products will not modify fund contracts to comply with the requirements of the 'Private Securities Investment Fund Operation Guidelines', maintaining the original contract terms and investment freedom unchanged. Linyuan Investment explained that the company's product investment operations have always adhered to a moderately concentrated, long-term investment style, which conflicts with the 'double 25%' portfolio investment restriction and bond investment ratio limits in the 'Operation Guidelines'. If forcibly modified, it would cause current or future forced portfolio adjustments for the products, which could materially harm the interests of existing holders under current and future market conditions. From August 1, 2026, customer-held products will no longer accept new subscriptions, and products will not be extended upon maturity, but will be liquidated normally according to contract terms.

headlines.title: 南开大学田利辉：优化逆周期调节机制 提升资本市场内在稳定性
headlines.summary: 【南开大学田利辉：优化逆周期调节机制 提升资本市场内在稳定性】7月30日召开的中央政治局会议强调，深化资本市场投融资综合改革，提升资本市场韧性和信心。在田利辉看来，后续举措可以聚焦三方面：通过优化逆周期调节机制、完善交易制度、强化风险隔离，提升市场内在稳定性；重点推动中长期资金入市比例提升，以“分红+回购”替代短期博弈，切实增强投资者获得感；严打市场操纵、财务造假与“绕道减持”。

headlines.title_en: Tian Lihui of Nankai University: Optimize counter-cyclical adjustment mechanisms to enhance intrinsic stability of capital markets
headlines.summary_en: [Nankai University Tian Lihui: Optimize Counter-Cyclical Adjustment Mechanism to Enhance Capital Market Intrinsic Stability] The Central Political Bureau meeting held on July 30 emphasized deepening comprehensive reform of capital market investment and financing to enhance capital market resilience and confidence. In Tian Lihui's view, subsequent measures can focus on three aspects: improving market intrinsic stability by optimizing counter-cyclical adjustment mechanisms, perfecting trading systems, and strengthening risk isolation; focusing on increasing the proportion of medium- and long-term funds entering the market, replacing short-term speculation with 'dividends + buybacks' to effectively enhance investor satisfaction; and strictly cracking down on market manipulation, financial fraud, and 'circumventing shareholding reduction'.

headlines.title: 工信部：废止和修订新能源汽车废旧动力电池“梯次利用”相关政策标准
headlines.summary: 工业和信息化部发布关于废止和修订新能源汽车废旧动力电池“梯次利用”相关政策标准以及规范有关行业活动的公告。废止《新能源汽车废旧动力电池综合利用行业规范条件》中“梯次利用”有关条款，不再开展“梯次利用”企业公告管理，将已公告的“梯次利用”企业移出符合新能源汽车废旧动力电池综合利用行业规范条件的企业名单，已公告的再生利用企业名单继续有效。

headlines.title_en: MIIT: Abolish and revise policy standards for 'cascade utilization' of new energy vehicle end-of-life power batteries
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology issued an announcement on abolishing and revising policy standards related to the 'cascade utilization' of used power batteries from new energy vehicles, as well as regulating related industry activities. It abolishes the relevant clauses on 'cascade utilization' in the 'Standard Conditions for the Comprehensive Utilization of Used Power Batteries from New Energy Vehicles', no longer manages announcements of 'cascade utilization' enterprises, removes already announced 'cascade utilization' enterprises from the list of enterprises meeting the standard conditions for comprehensive utilization of used new energy vehicle power batteries, while the list of already announced recycling enterprises remains valid.

headlines.title: 渤海租赁：拟以2亿元回购公司股份，回购价格上限6.48元/股
headlines.summary: 渤海租赁公告，拟以自有资金及股票回购专项贷款，通过集中竞价交易方式回购公司股份，回购金额为人民币2亿元（含），回购价格不超过人民币6.48元/股（含）。按价格上限测算，预计回购股份约3086.42万股，占公司总股本的0.50%。回购股份全部用于为维护公司价值及股东权益所必需，将全部用于出售。回购期限为自董事会审议通过之日起3个月内。

headlines.title_en: Bohai Leasing: Plans to repurchase 200 million yuan in company shares at a repurchase price ceiling of 6.48 yuan per share
headlines.summary_en: Bohai Leasing announced that it plans to use its own funds and special stock buyback loans to repurchase company shares through centralized bidding transactions, with a repurchase amount of RMB 200 million (inclusive) and a repurchase price not exceeding RMB 6.48 per share (inclusive). Based on the price cap, it is estimated that approximately 30.8642 million shares will be repurchased, accounting for 0.50% of the company's total share capital. The repurchased shares are all used for maintaining company value and shareholder rights as necessary and will be fully used for resale. The repurchase period is within three months from the date of board approval.

headlines.title: 市场监管总局：饮料类食品安全抽检 合格率达99.45%
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月30日讯，从国家市场监督管理总局了解到，6月以来，全国各级市场监管部门共抽检饮料5.09万批次，抽检合格率达到99.45%，饮料食品安全总体状况良好。此次抽检覆盖生产企业、餐饮单位、超市、食堂、小摊贩以及网络销售平台等多个环节，重点针对果蔬汁类饮料、包装饮用水、蛋白饮料等消费量较大的产品，开展微生物、食品添加剂、重金属、有机污染物等8大类214个项目检测。

headlines.title_en: SAMR: Food safety sampling inspection for beverages shows pass rate of 99.45%
headlines.summary_en: Golden Ten Data on July 30 reports: According to the State Administration for Market Regulation, since June, market regulatory authorities nationwide have sampled a total of 50,900 batches of beverages, with a pass rate of 99.45%. The overall food safety situation for beverages is good. The sampling covered multiple links including production enterprises, catering units, supermarkets, canteens, street vendors, and online sales platforms, focusing on high-consumption products such as fruit and vegetable juice beverages, packaged drinking water, and protein beverages, testing 214 items across 8 major categories including microorganisms, food additives, heavy metals, and organic pollutants.

headlines.summary_en: Southbound capital net sold off a substantial HK$8.571 billion today. headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Over 90% of national-level economic development zones adopt 'Management Committee + Company' model
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce held a regular press conference. MOFCOM spokesperson He Yadong introduced the development status of national-level economic and technological development zones. He stated that since the establishment of the first batch of 14 national-level economic and technological development zones in 1984, they have persisted in expanding opening-up and deepening reform and innovation, gradually becoming a main battlefield for stabilizing foreign trade and foreign investment, a gathering area for the development of new quality productive forces, and a strong engine for regional coordinated development. This is mainly reflected in the following four aspects: First, their status as the 'top echelon' in foreign trade and foreign investment has become more stable. Second, their leading and exemplary role in technological innovation and guidance is increasingly prominent. Third, their role as strategic fulcrums in serving regional coordinated development continues to strengthen.

headlines.title: 商务部公布2025年国家级经济技术开发区综合发展水平考核评价结果
headlines.summary: 商务部公布2025年国家级经济技术开发区综合发展水平考核评价结果。2024年，国家级经开区实现地区生产总值15.4万亿元，占国内生产总值比重为11.4%；税收收入占所在地级市税收收入比重为25.8%，较前一年增长1.1个百分点；截至2024年末，国家级经开区拥有上市企业1096家，同比增长5.3%。2024年，国家级经开区实现进出口总额10.6万亿元，占全国进出口总额比重为24.1%；高新技术产品进出口额2.8万亿元，占全国高新技术产品进出口额比重为23.8%。实际使用外资金额268.4亿美元，占全国实际使用外资比重为23.1%。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce releases 2025 comprehensive development level assessment results for national-level economic and technological development zones
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) released the 2025 comprehensive development level evaluation results for national-level economic and technological development zones. In 2024, these zones achieved a gross domestic product of 15.4 trillion yuan, accounting for 11.4% of the national GDP; their tax revenue accounted for 25.8% of the tax revenue of their respective prefecture-level cities, up 1.1 percentage points year-on-year. As of end-2024, the zones housed 1,096 listed companies, up 5.3% year-on-year. In 2024, they realized a total import and export volume of 10.6 trillion yuan, representing 24.1% of the national total; high-tech product imports and exports reached 2.8 trillion yuan, accounting for 23.8% of the national high-tech product trade. Actual utilized foreign capital stood at US$26.84 billion, representing 23.1% of the national total.

headlines.title: 商务部：将优化国家级经开区考核评价指标体系
headlines.summary: 商务部新闻发言人何亚东介绍，2024年，国家级经开区实现进出口总额10.6万亿元，实际使用外资金额268.4亿美元，均占全国总额近1/4，集聚了11万余家外贸企业、7万余家外资企业。 何亚东：下一步，商务部将优化国家级经开区考核评价指标体系，完善动态管理制度，不断激发创新活力和内生动力，推动国家级经开区规范提升、实现高质量发展。（央视）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Will optimize the assessment and evaluation indicator system for national-level economic and technological development zones
headlines.summary_en: MOFCOM spokesperson He Yadong noted that in 2024, national-level economic and technological development zones achieved total imports and exports of 10.6 trillion yuan and actual utilized foreign capital of US$26.84 billion, each accounting for nearly a quarter of the national totals. The zones gathered over 110,000 foreign trade enterprises and over 70,000 foreign-invested enterprises. He Yadong said: Next, MOFCOM will optimize the evaluation indicator system for these zones, improve dynamic management mechanisms, continuously stimulate innovation vitality and endogenous momentum, and promote standardized upgrading and high-quality development of national-level economic and technological development zones. (CCTV)
